# `cellquadrature`

the quadrature ingredients per spatial tile (and tile pair), per time tile and per burst, from an analytic cross-spectrum.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run cellquadrature --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run cellquadrature --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run cellquadrature --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --cross-spectrum rest_crossspectrum_alpha_windows --joint "cortex tiles x frames (rest)" --spatial-scale "parts 8" --bursts "rest alpha bursts"
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `cross_spectrum` | statistic any, where {"name": "$cross_spectrum"} | yes |
| `recording` | field recording, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, where {"name": "$kernel"} | yes |
| `joint` | selection set, where {"name": "$joint"} (the joint cells of the surface's level and the cross-spectrum's tile level (`nxr-neuro run select_product` first, or composed by `run measure`)) | yes |
| `bursts` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$bursts"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cross_spectrum` | `--cross-spectrum` | none | - |  | the analytic cross-spectrum's name (<name>_<band>_windows) |
| `recording` | `--recording` | none | - |  | the recording the cross-spectrum is of (the measurements are of it) |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the inverse kernel's name (free or fixed orientation), or none: the subject's one inverse kernel |
| `joint` | `--joint` | none | - |  | the joint cells' name (its time level is the cross-spectrum's tile level) |
| `bursts` | `--bursts` | none | - |  | a spans selection of bursts on the recording's time line: also made per burst; null: the cells only |
| `spatial_scale` | `--spatial-scale` | none | mm |  | the spatial band as a quantity: a tile diameter, a wavelength, parts per hemisphere or a named scale; its Weyl band is the spatial band, its tiles the spatial partition |
| `weights` | `--weights` | `area` | - | area, none | area = the vertices count by the area they stand for (barycentric) \| none = every vertex counts equally |
| `tile_pairs` | `--tile-pairs` | true | - |  | also the cross-tile blocks of the level's touching tiles |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - |  | the spatial band's transform: auto (eigenmodes first, chebyshev an announced fallback) \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact |
| `modes` | `--modes` | none | - |  | the eigenmodes made when the package is computed; null: the standard |
| `order` | `--order` | none | - |  | the Chebyshev order; null: from the tolerance |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | none | - |  | the Chebyshev tolerance; null: the default |

## Notes from the definition

```text
QUADRATURE PER CELL AND PER BURST: travelling or standing? From a band's analytic cross-spectrum on time tiles (`nxr-neuro run measure --set analytic_cross_spectrum_tiles`), the kernel and the joint cells, per spatial tile
of a level T = B C B^T (B the tile's rows of the kernel with the level's Weyl band, all components; C a time tile's cross-spectrum on the kernel's channels), stored as the two additive
ingredients sum |T|^2 and sum |Im T|^2 (the quadrature fraction is derived at read): per time tile of the joint cells, and per burst (C summed over the burst's tiles first: products add). With
tile_pairs also the cross-tile blocks of the level's touching tiles (nxr::select::tileAdjacency order): a wave running from one tile into the next is there, not in the within-tile blocks.
The tile level of the cross-spectrum must equal the joint cells' time level.

  nxr-neuro run cellquadrature --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --cross-spectrum rest_crossspectrum_alpha_windows --joint "cortex tiles x frames (rest)" --spatial-scale "parts 8" --bursts "rest alpha bursts"
```
